title: CSCI 633 — Biologically Inspired Intelligent Systems
subject: Artificial Intelligence
description: An independent, catalog-aligned learning companion. It is not an official RIT course section or a replacement for the instructor's syllabus.
outcomes: Define the core components of the NIST AI Risk Management Framework and explain how each phase addresses AI deployment risks.
Explain how machine-learning workflows prevent data leakage and ensure consistent preprocessing through pipeline construction.
Identify how biologically inspired computational models leverage principles from neuroscience and cognitive science to solve complex problems.
